entry.title: New: RES23-256 (Honolulu) — FILE
entry.content:
ACCEPTING A GIFT OF TRAVEL, LODGING, REGISTRATION FEE AND MEALS VALUED AT $2,186 TO THE CITY FROM NATIONAL LEAGUE OF CITIES (NLC) FOR THE JOB RESOURCE SPECIALIST OF THE DEPARTMENT OF COMMUNITY SERVICES TO ATTEND THE 2023 NATIONAL LEAGUE OF CITIES SUMMIT IN ATLANTA, GEORGIA FROM NOVEMBER 14-16, 2023.

Latest action: Filed pursuant to ROH SEC 1-2.5 which sets a one-year filing period on pending resolutions.
